info.title: How it works
info.intro: bubbler schedules peace bubbles for our Evony circle so nobody has to babysit a shield.
info.bubblesBody: An automatic truce on Evony: the app opens a shield on the right Evony server for you, at the scheduled times, so your city can't be attacked.
info.defaultBody: New members get three individual slots: Monday 09:00, Wednesday 09:00 and Friday 18:00 (Evony server time, UTC) — each day keeps its own time, each run opens a three-day window. The operator can change any slot to suit your real game time.
info.i18nBody: We're a far-flung circle, so the whole app switches language. Pick yours in the menu — your schedule is the same everywhere, just in your words.
info.privateBody: No open signup, no passwords. Your email is your login — if you're not on the invite list, the app won't let you in.
